title: Loudspeaker-to-Microphone Continuous Sequence Collapse
severity: Critical for ambient room deployment; Low for close-talk headset
root_cause: Micro-speaker low-frequency cutoff (<280Hz) and room reverberation (RT60 ~0.35s) fill in inter-syllable valleys and distort vocalic formants
current_mitigation: Bound operational scope to direct digital stream and close-talk headsets (90-100% exact match)
phase8_remediation_roadmap: Execute Phase 8 controlled acoustic augmentation retraining on the 138k architecture using Phase 7B pipeline

title: Open-Microphone False Activation on Natural Speech
severity: High for passive ambient listening; Negligible for Game Mode
root_cause: Acoustic valleys occur naturally between syllables in human conversational speech
current_mitigation: Mandatory GameModeSessionController gating (Push-to-Talk or 6.0s timeout auto-extended)
phase8_remediation_roadmap: Maintain session-gate isolation for demo; research dual-stage neural VAD for ambient continuous listening

title: Regional Accent and Speaker Inventory Ceiling
root_cause: Corpus inventory is capped at 50 clips per class across 8 Northern accent speakers
current_mitigation: Independent holdout manifest isolating 3 Northern speakers with 0 tuning overlap
phase8_remediation_roadmap: Expand native speech dataset to >=50 native speakers across Northern Central and Southern dialects
